name: Real BMI Calculator
description: Evidence-based health, body composition, and metabolic calculators based on WHO and CDC clinical reference standards.

tools.name: calculate_bmi
tools.description: Calculates Body Mass Index (BMI) using weight (kg or lbs) and height (cm or inches), returning WHO and CDC health risk categories.

tools.name: calculate_bmr
tools.description: Calculates Basal Metabolic Rate using the Mifflin-St Jeor clinical equation.

tools.name: calculate_tdee
tools.description: Calculates Total Daily Energy Expenditure based on BMR and physical activity factors.

tools.name: calculate_body_fat
tools.description: Calculates body fat percentage using US Navy circumference formulas.

tools.name: calculate_ideal_weight
tools.description: Calculates healthy weight ranges using Devine, Robinson, Miller, and Hamwi equations.
